neighbours.label: ' also' opening an alternative-name apposition after a name (X, also known as / also called / also referred to as Y); additive 'also' in other uses stays low
fire: The river Thames, also known as the Isis in Oxford, flows east to London.
Ibuprofen, also sold as Advil, reduces fever and swelling.
Mount Everest, also called Chomolungma, lies on the border with Tibet.
The Great Depression, also referred to as the Slump, began in 1929.
Mumbai, also known as Bombay, is the capital of Maharashtra.
Vitamin C, also called ascorbic acid, is found in citrus fruit.
Saint Nicholas, also known as Nicholas of Myra, was a Greek bishop.
The Netherlands, also referred to as Holland, is famous for its canals.
quiet: The river Thames flows east to London and is also crossed by many bridges.
Ibuprofen reduces fever and is also useful against swelling.
Climbers on Mount Everest also face strong winds near the summit.
The Great Depression began in 1929 and also hurt farmers badly.
Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra and also a major port.
Citrus fruit contains vitamin C and also some fibre.
Nicholas was a Greek bishop who also gave gifts to the poor.
The Netherlands is famous for its canals and also for its cheese.
